description: This file contains unit tests for operator registration and kernel dispatching in PyTorch, including kernel registration, dispatch key handling, and fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: errorKernel
methods.description: Kernel that should never be called, used for testing error handling.

methods.name: incrementKernel
methods.description: Kernel that increments an integer input.

methods.name: decrementKernel
methods.description: Kernel that decrements an integer input.

methods.name: redispatchingKernel_with_DispatchKeySet
methods.description: Kernel that redispatches to a lower-priority kernel based on dispatch key set.

methods.name: expectCallsIncrement
methods.description: Test helper to verify increment kernel is called with specific dispatch key set.

methods.name: expectCallsIncrementUnboxed
methods.description: Test helper to verify unboxed increment call.

methods.name: expectCallsDecrement
methods.description: Test helper to verify decrement kernel is called with specific dispatch key set.

methods.name: kernelWithoutInputs
methods.description: Fallback kernel without inputs, sets a flag when called.

methods.name: kernelWithoutTensorInputs
methods.description: Fallback kernel that increments the top of the stack.

methods.name: kernelForSchemaInference
methods.description: Kernel used to test registration failure when schema cannot be inferred.
